_about: What the player can choose to focus on while time jumps forward between played days. Effects use the same shape as life events: needs, money, skills, traits, bondTag (people with that tag who you've met).

focuses.label: Explore everything
focuses.summary: You explored every corner of the house. Nothing was safe from your little hands.

focuses.label: Stay close to family
focuses.summary: You were held a lot. Your family's voices became the most familiar sounds in the world.

focuses.label: Be loud
focuses.summary: You learned that if you were loud enough, someone always came.

focuses.label: School and study
focuses.summary: You worked hard at school. Your teachers noticed.

focuses.label: Friends
focuses.hint: Play, hang out, go places together.
focuses.summary: You spent your days with friends. Those were good days.

focuses.label: Family
focuses.hint: Help at home, spend time together.
focuses.summary: You stayed close to home and to your family.

focuses.label: Play outside
focuses.summary: You were outside from morning to dark, scraped knees and all.

focuses.label: Earn money
focuses.summary: You found ways to earn a little money, and kept most of it.

focuses.label: Make things
focuses.summary: You made things with your hands, and some of them were even good.

focuses.label: Rest and health
focuses.hint: Sleep well, eat well, slow down.
focuses.summary: You took care of yourself. Your body thanked you.

focuses.label: Work
focuses.summary: You worked long hours. The money came in, and so did the tiredness.
